ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
It is hereby informed to all concerned that the tentative date of commencement of written
examination mentioned in the "APPSC Programme of Examinations/Recruitment Tests
(RTs) -2024" for the post of Trained Graduate Teacher (Class IX to X) under the
Directorate of Secondary Education, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh has been postponed as the
date was clashing with the CSL Examination of APSSB, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh. The new
date for the Commencement of TGT Examination shall be notified shortly.
1. The Hon'ble Chairman, APPSC.
2. The Secretary, APSSB.
3. APPSC website.
4. Office copy.
Dated Itanagar the 7th October. 2024
NOTIFICATION
(Parul Gaur Mittal), IRS
